topic.title: How to Add Support for S1000D Schemas in Oxygen XML Editor
topic.shortdesc: Learn how to configure Oxygen XML Editor to use additional or customized S1000D schemas for validation and content completion.

body.p: includes built-in support for S1000D issues 4.0, 4.1, and 4.2. If you need to work with a different issue, a customized schema set, or project-specific S1000D extensions, you can add support by creating or customizing a document type association.

The general approach is to point the document type configuration to the appropriate S1000D schema resources and then configure any related catalogs, validation scenarios, and authoring support as needed.

ol.li: Create or identify the S1000D schema files that you want to use.
Make sure any required XML catalogs are available so that schema references can be resolved correctly.
Create a custom document type association or extend the existing S1000D framework.
Configure the validation schema and any additional validation scenarios.
Optionally customize Author mode, templates, and actions for your project-specific workflow.

section.title: Related Information
section.p: For more information about configuring frameworks and document types, see the topics about document type associations, frameworks, and XML catalogs.
